project.name: Mac Control guarded invocation
project.identity: The Mac Control invocation plane that binds actions to authority, target identity, and safe outcomes.
project.audience: Local operators and agent workflows with an explicitly authorized Mac control task.
project.core_loop: Resolve the exact target, check capabilities and authority, execute only the allowed action, and return a receipt or reason-coded refusal.
project.north_star: No local action occurs without the right target, authority, capability, and observable result.
not_this: Treating unsupported providers as successful control

scope.purpose: Accept explicit local control intent, apply authorization and capability gates, and return a permission-aware result.
scope.boundary: Owns action intent, control sessions, task control, workflow execution, and CLI entry points; focus layout, diagnostics, and release projection remain outside this child.
non_goals: Treating unsupported providers as successful control

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The Mac Control guarded invocation boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.
